units.rawText: Visual systems, 10% damage. Debug mode, booting. Projected imaging distortion, less than 5%.
units.displayText: Visual systems, 10% damage. Debug mode, booting. Projected imaging distortion, less than 5%.

spans.text: Visual systems, 10% damage. Debug mode, booting. Projected imaging distortion, less than 5%.

units.rawText: So bright...
units.displayText: So bright...

spans.text: So bright...

units.rawText: Under the glaring light, Undine squints her eyes until her visual systems adjusts and clarity returns.
units.displayText: Under the glaring light, Undine squints her eyes until her visual systems adjusts and clarity returns.

spans.text: Under the glaring light, Undine squints her eyes until her visual systems adjusts and clarity returns.

units.rawText: Along with it comes the disharmony of metal on metal.
units.displayText: Along with it comes the disharmony of metal on metal.

spans.text: Along with it comes the disharmony of metal on metal.

units.rawText: These things, yeah? Three modifications, all installed, then get rid of the old stuff, right?
units.displayText: These things, yeah? Three modifications, all installed, then get rid of the old stuff, right?

spans.text: These things, yeah? Three modifications, all installed, then get rid of the old stuff, right?

units.rawText: Like they said, just the small ones will do. It's not a big deal if they get torn up. Big one needs to go as well.
units.displayText: Like they said, just the small ones will do. It's not a big deal if they get torn up. Big one needs to go as well.

spans.text: Like they said, just the small ones will do. It's not a big deal if they get torn up. Big one needs to go as well.

units.rawText: (The small ones—do they mean them? What? "Not a big deal if they get torn up"?)
units.displayText: The small ones—do they mean them? What? "Not a big deal if they get torn up"?

spans.text: The small ones—do they mean them? What? "Not a big deal if they get torn up"?

units.rawText:
<size=28>Dididi, beeeep—
(Report, bodily, damage.)</size>
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Report, bodily, damage.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Report, bodily, damage.)

units.rawText: (I can't move my body... No, I can't just let them take us apart!)
units.displayText: I can't move my body... No, I can't just let them take us apart!

spans.text: I can't move my body... No, I can't just let them take us apart!

units.rawText: Force boot, successful. Warning, body overheating, overload above 35%.
units.displayText: Force boot, successful. Warning, body overheating, overload above 35%.

spans.text: Force boot, successful. Warning, body overheating, overload above 35%.

units.rawText: Alright, I got it. I'm the most notable technician around these parts, so no need to worry about something as minute as this. Not a soul will ever find out. Anyway, about what this'll set you back by...
units.displayText: Alright, I got it. I'm the most notable technician around these parts, so no need to worry about something as minute as this. Not a soul will ever find out. Anyway, about what this'll set you back by...

spans.text: Alright, I got it. I'm the most notable technician around these parts, so no need to worry about something as minute as this. Not a soul will ever find out. Anyway, about what this'll set you back by...

units.rawText: (It's crawling with men in black outside! All the exits are blocked off.)
units.displayText: It's crawling with men in black outside! All the exits are blocked off.

spans.text: It's crawling with men in black outside! All the exits are blocked off.

units.rawText:
<size=28>Dididi, beeeep—
(Reconnaissance, complete.)</size>
units.displayText:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Reconnaissance, complete.)

spans.text:
Dididi, beeeep—
(Reconnaissance, complete.)

units.rawText: (No, there's still the windows. If I can make it out one—)
units.displayText: No, there's still the windows. If I can make it out one—

spans.text: No, there's still the windows. If I can make it out one—

units.rawText: It's all the same. Don't worry, there'll be no lack of payment.
units.displayText: It's all the same. Don't worry, there'll be no lack of payment.

spans.text: It's all the same. Don't worry, there'll be no lack of payment.

units.rawText: Oi, these things you brought in are already booted up? Are they modified or something? This is way too fast!
units.displayText: Oi, these things you brought in are already booted up? Are they modified or something? This is way too fast!

spans.text: Oi, these things you brought in are already booted up? Are they modified or something? This is way too fast!

units.rawText: (No, I need to stall a bit more, just a bit more time for everyone to recover!)
units.displayText: No, I need to stall a bit more, just a bit more time for everyone to recover!

spans.text: No, I need to stall a bit more, just a bit more time for everyone to recover!

units.rawText: Damn, what a shame. Wanted to save you all a bit of the pain.
units.displayText: Damn, what a shame. Wanted to save you all a bit of the pain.

spans.text: Damn, what a shame. Wanted to save you all a bit of the pain.

units.rawText: <size=28>What... are you doing?</size>
units.displayText: What... are you doing?

spans.text: What... are you doing?

units.rawText: (Hey, you... Guys, get ready. Two groups; one goes up, and the other circles around when they come over.)
units.displayText: Hey, you... Guys, get ready. Two groups; one goes up, and the other circles around when they come over.

spans.text: Hey, you... Guys, get ready. Two groups; one goes up, and the other circles around when they come over.

units.rawText: (There's not that many guards over there, so few seconds should be enough. When you're up, pull the others up with you. I can stall a bit more.)
units.displayText: There's not that many guards over there, so few seconds should be enough. When you're up, pull the others up with you. I can stall a bit more.

spans.text: There's not that many guards over there, so few seconds should be enough. When you're up, pull the others up with you. I can stall a bit more.

units.rawText:
(Dididi, beeeep—)
(Command, received.)
units.displayText:
(Dididi, beeeep—)
(Command, received.)

spans.text:
(Dididi, beeeep—)
(Command, received.)

units.rawText: Does how fast they boot impact your work? If it doesn't, then get on with it!
units.displayText: Does how fast they boot impact your work? If it doesn't, then get on with it!

spans.text: Does how fast they boot impact your work? If it doesn't, then get on with it!

units.rawText: (Now!)
units.displayText: Now!

spans.text: Now!

units.rawText: Hmm?
units.displayText: Hmm?

spans.text: Hmm?

units.rawText: (Sorry, but—I can't just let you destroy them like this!)
units.displayText: Sorry, but—I can't just let you destroy them like this!

spans.text: Sorry, but—I can't just let you destroy them like this!

units.rawText: Hey! You pieces of—
units.displayText: Hey! You pieces of—

spans.text: Hey! You pieces of—

units.rawText: Undine raises her conductor's staff, blocking the humans' line of sight.
units.displayText: Undine raises her conductor's staff, blocking the humans' line of sight.

spans.text: Undine raises her conductor's staff, blocking the humans' line of sight.

units.rawText: The hell, this Doll hits people?! Did you guys disable the restrictions on them?!
units.displayText: The hell, this Doll hits people?! Did you guys disable the restrictions on them?!

spans.text: The hell, this Doll hits people?! Did you guys disable the restrictions on them?!

units.rawText: (Neural estimations complete, the perfect angle... Downwards!)
units.displayText: Neural estimations complete, the perfect angle... Downwards!

spans.text: Neural estimations complete, the perfect angle... Downwards!

units.rawText: Contrary to the humans' expectations, as the staff made contact with the ground, Undine leaps upwards with the leverage, jumping towards the window—
units.displayText: Contrary to the humans' expectations, as the staff made contact with the ground, Undine leaps upwards with the leverage, jumping towards the window—

spans.text: Contrary to the humans' expectations, as the staff made contact with the ground, Undine leaps upwards with the leverage, jumping towards the window—

units.rawText: Outside team, move it!
units.displayText: Outside team, move it!

spans.text: Outside team, move it!

units.rawText: Yes!
units.displayText: Yes!

spans.text: Yes!

units.rawText: (What? There were more behind there?)
units.displayText: What? There were more behind there?

spans.text: What? There were more behind there?

units.rawText: By the time she realizes, it is too late.
units.displayText: By the time she realizes, it is too late.

spans.text: By the time she realizes, it is too late.

units.rawText: Undine had put her all into jumping away, but inertia is not nullified so easily. She is aware she is plummeting into the suddenly revealed ambush.
units.displayText: Undine had put her all into jumping away, but inertia is not nullified so easily. She is aware she is plummeting into the suddenly revealed ambush.

spans.text: Undine had put her all into jumping away, but inertia is not nullified so easily. She is aware she is plummeting into the suddenly revealed ambush.

units.rawText:
Beep—
(We, still—)
units.displayText:
Beep—
(We, still—)

spans.text:
Beep—
(We, still—)

units.rawText: Dolce—
units.displayText: Dolce—

spans.text: Dolce—

units.rawText: Clang!
units.displayText: Clang!

spans.text: Clang!

units.rawText: (What, happened...)
units.displayText: What, happened...

spans.text: What, happened...

units.rawText: She can no longer discern the sounds surrounding her, whether it's the swarming mutterings or vicious obscenities.
units.displayText: She can no longer discern the sounds surrounding her, whether it's the swarming mutterings or vicious obscenities.

spans.text: She can no longer discern the sounds surrounding her, whether it's the swarming mutterings or vicious obscenities.

units.rawText: Putting itself between harm and Undine, an aide falls to the ground, unmoving.
units.displayText: Putting itself between harm and Undine, an aide falls to the ground, unmoving.

spans.text: Putting itself between harm and Undine, an aide falls to the ground, unmoving.

units.rawText: Beep...
units.displayText: Beep...

spans.text: Beep...

units.rawText: Tranquillo, Scherzando, and Maestoso soon follow. To give her whatever time they can to flee, the aides throw themselves between her and the attacks.
units.displayText: Tranquillo, Scherzando, and Maestoso soon follow. To give her whatever time they can to flee, the aides throw themselves between her and the attacks.

spans.text: Tranquillo, Scherzando, and Maestoso soon follow. To give her whatever time they can to flee, the aides throw themselves between her and the attacks.

units.rawText: Undine wants to speak, but with a moment of hesitation, she falls into the clutches of an unknown force, with no more opportunities for redemption.
units.displayText: Undine wants to speak, but with a moment of hesitation, she falls into the clutches of an unknown force, with no more opportunities for redemption.

spans.text: Undine wants to speak, but with a moment of hesitation, she falls into the clutches of an unknown force, with no more opportunities for redemption.

units.rawText: (Dolce, Tranquillo, Scherzando, Maestoso...)
units.displayText: Dolce, Tranquillo, Scherzando, Maestoso...

spans.text: Dolce, Tranquillo, Scherzando, Maestoso...

units.rawText: (Come to think of it, they've always had their own names, but why did I... not call them by their names until today?)
units.displayText: Come to think of it, they've always had their own names, but why did I... not call them by their names until today?

spans.text: Come to think of it, they've always had their own names, but why did I... not call them by their names until today?

units.rawText: That is her last thought before forced hibernation overtakes her.
units.displayText: That is her last thought before forced hibernation overtakes her.

spans.text: That is her last thought before forced hibernation overtakes her.
